manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Shows the motion and velocity-time graph of a tossed ball. Demonstrates that gravity causes constant downward acceleration, even at the top where velocity is zero.
manifest.description: Left, a ball moves vertically on a height scale from 0 to 2.2 meters with velocity, acceleration, and force indicators. Right, a velocity-time plot shows a linear decline with slope equal to negative gravity.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
